title: Creature Tracks: Giganticus
description: Creature Tracks: Giganticus — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Slimy Giganticus Tracks

Quest Type: GoTo / Kill

Quest Description: Find 3 sets of Poison Giganticus Tracks and Hunt down and Kill the Poison Giganticus then Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Slimy Giganticus Tracks

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find 3 sets of Poison Giganticus Tracks and Hunt down and Kill the Poison Giganticus then Return to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Offer:

You see some tracks on the ground and they look like nothing you have ever seen before and then, all of a sudden, you recall something a dungeon sherpa once told you....

The Giganticus is an ancient creature and one that has fought for every inch of it's survival. Those things are huge, so that is like, a bajillion inches worth of fight! You are dead meat!

Some think that since the Giganticus is so rare we need to gather as much information about it as you can before it becomes extinct. Others think that we should kill them as much as possible before they become extinct because it is just plain good ol' fun.

You see that the tracks lead in to Level 6 of the Widower's Nest and think that is where you should start. If you find all the tracks of the Poison Giganticus they should lead you right to it.

When you have tracked down and vanquished this foe report to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

What happened? You found and killed a Poison Giganticus? You are soooo lucky! You know they are almost extinct, right?

Objectives:

  • Find a Set of Tracks 1
  • Find a Set of Tracks 2
  • Find a Set of Tracks 3
  • Slay the Poison Giganticus

Level range: 30–40
